speaker: gauge
text: A stray arrow on the fuel gauge. Printing mistake. I'll scrape it off.

speaker: fitz
text: Wait. It points to your fuel door's side.

speaker: gauge
text: Isn't it always the same side?

speaker: fitz
text:
No. Carmakers choose a side for each car, often to fit the tank. So in a borrowed car, it's easy to guess wrong.
A Ford designer got it wrong in the rain in 1986. He suggested a symbol by the gauge. Ford started adding it with 1989 models.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
